headline: Pull the last rivet — and the girders come down
lede: DONKEY KONG's arcade promise now pays off: climb to Pauline, pull the four rivets out from under DK, and the whole top of the tower collapses in a heap of tilting girders before the board rebuilds for the next lap.

notes.text: The rivet finale shipped (#3609): 30-tick pull freeze per rivet (+100), girders 5/6 tilt-fall on the last pull, DK drops 160 px, +1000 lap bank and a fresh board 150 ticks later. 24/24 autopilot seeds win the lap with byte-identical replays.

Kongcheck grew to 99 gates and 28 mutants (all dead); a new kongdrive runs the finale in real Chrome — real keys lift the runner, the WATCH seat pulls all four rivets and banks the lap, and the crash provably repaints the field (11/11).

Handed QA a finale polish pass (#3615): pull-freeze feel, crush-readability on phones, rivet pixel alignment, and sourcing the arcade's real rivet-stage score tables — the honest gap the finale leaves open.

look.text: Pull all four rivets and watch DK fall — the new finale
